founder.name: Pujyasri Swami Omkarananda Mahaswamigal
founder.role: Founder of Sri Swami Chidbhavananda Ashramam
founder.bio: Pujyasri Omkarananda Mahaswamigal was born in a Vaidika family, deeply rooted in tradition and culture. He embraced the Vedic lifestyle from early childhood. An erudite scholar and Ganapati in his purvashrama, he was proficient in both Tamil and Sanskrit Vedanta texts.
founder.quote: One who works for purity of mind never loses. He learns to cleanse his mind from texts such as Thirukural.

omkarananda.name: Pujyasri Omkarananda Mahaswamigal
omkarananda.role: Ghanapathi, Vedanta teacher and founder of Sri Swami Chidbhavananda Ashramam
omkarananda.intro: Born into a Vaidika family and raised in the Vedic way of life from early childhood, Swamiji became a scholar of both Tamil and Sanskrit Vedanta, and a teacher whose simplicity and compassion won the love of thousands of devotees around the world.
omkarananda.lifeTitle: A life of Veda and Vedanta

life.title: Rooted in the Vedas
life.text: Born into a Vaidika family steeped in tradition and culture, he took up the Vedic lifestyle from early childhood. In his purvashrama he was a Ghanapathi, well versed in the Veda Purva Bhaga and the Vedanta Shastra.

life.title: A scholar of two languages
life.text: He was proficient in the Vedanta texts of both Tamil and Sanskrit. Scholars respected him widely, and he received accolades across the country.

life.title: A teacher without notes
life.text: His lectures were always extempore, never read from notes, and reflected a vast and deep knowledge. Thousands of hours of his talks have been recorded and preserved.

life.title: A heart full of devotion
life.text: His devotion to Ishwara showed in his soulful renditions of divine songs and slokas. Anyone who met his ever-smiling presence found it a joyful experience.

gurus.name: Pujyasri Swami Chidbhavananda
gurus.text: Swamiji received sanyasa initiation from Pujyasri Swami Chidbhavananda, whose name the ashram he founded carries.

gurus.name: Swami Paramarthananda
gurus.text: He studied Vedanta under Swami Paramarthananda, one of the foremost disciples of Pujyasri Dayananda Saraswati.

omkarananda.tamilTitle: A master of the Tamil scriptures
omkarananda.tamilText: Swamiji was an expert in the Tamil scriptures and a household name in Tamil Nadu during his lifetime. His expertise included the works below.

quote.text: Spiritual aspirants who study texts such as Gita are often mocked at, as ones who do not know the art of survival.
quote.note: Only those who study the Gita, he said, can endure life's sorrows and its ups and downs.

omkarananda.missionText: Swamiji founded Sri Swami Chidbhavananda Ashramam at Vedapuri, Theni, and established the Vedanta Sastra Prachara Trust to spread Vedantic teachings. He also built the Dakshinamurthi temple at the ashram.
omkarananda.address: Sri Swami Chidbhavananda Ashramam, Chatrapatti Road, Vedapuri, Theni, Tamil Nadu 625 531
omkarananda.adhText: Swamiji attained Maha Samadhi on 10 May 2021. An Adhishtanam, a sanctified memorial, stands opposite the Dakshinamurthi temple he built. Regular pujas are held there.

omkarananda.listenText: Thousands of hours of Swamiji's lectures have been recorded and preserved.
